name: auth_rls_initplan
title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
description: Detects if calls to `current_setting()` and `auth.<function>()` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row
detail: Table `shareholder_register_filing.production_feedback_artifacts` has a row level security policy `rf151_documents_reference_read` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing `auth.<function>()` with `(select auth.<function>())`. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.
